text:
```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Weekly at midnight UTC

jobs:
  build-and-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Bump version and create tag
      run: npx semantic-release --no-ci

    - name: Generate release notes
      id: generate_release_notes
      uses: release-drafter/release-drafter@v6
      with:
        config-name: .github/release-drafter.yml
        name: ${{ github.event.release.name }}
        tag: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
        version: ${{ github.event.release.version }}
        publish: true
        latest: false
        prerelease: false
        prerelease-identifier: ''
        include-pre-releases: false
        commitish: ${{ github.ref }}
        header: '# Changelog'
        footer: ''

    - name: Create release
      id: create_release
      uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        body: ${{ steps.generate_release_notes.outputs.body }}
        name: ${{ github.event.release.name }}
        tag_name: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
        draft: false
        prerelease: false
        repository: icebear0828/codex-proxy

    - name: Upload assets
      uses: WebFreak001/deploy-nightly@46ecbabd7fad70d3e7d2c97fe8cd54e7a52e215b
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
        release_id: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.id }}
        asset_path: dist/
        asset_name: codex-proxy-${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}.zip
        asset_content_type: application/zip
        max_releases: 5
        ignore_hash: false
```
